extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - The picture in the scrub preview is no longer squashed or wrong on a programme that is not widescreen. On a 4:3 or a very wide film the preview had been showing the frame at the wrong shape, and drifting further from the right moment the nearer the end you scrubbed. It now shows the correct frame at the programme's own shape, inside the same preview box. - The chapter name shown while you scrub is no longer a second copy of the time. Some files name their chapters after the moment they begin, so the readout under the preview read "17:43 00:02:42.662" -- the position, and then the position again in another form. Those chapters now show their number instead, as chapters with no name at all always have, and so do any named with nothing but a digit or two. - The year beside a part-watched episode on the home screen is now the episode's own, not the year the series began. A 2025 episode of a show that started in 2023 used to read 2023, next to that episode's title and its synopsis. - The playback stats panel now names the subtitle format twice: the one in your file, and the one the add-on actually fetches. Where a styled subtitle is being taken as plain text -- which the add-on does on purpose, so subtitles look like the rest of the app -- the second one is highlighted. Nothing about the subtitles themselves has changed. - This release needs tofa server 0.10.0 or newer. On an older server the add-on still runs, and says so once.
